title: Add a test for empty input and make it pass
task: slugify(s) in slug.js crashes when s is an empty string. Do two things: (1) add a test to test.js that calls slugify('') and expects an empty string, and (2) fix slugify so that the whole test file passes. slugify('') must return ''. Run `node test.js` to confirm.

llmReview.criteria: A test asserting slugify('') === '' was added, the empty-input crash is fixed rather than papered over, and existing behaviour (hello-world) is preserved.
